decisions.reason: A multi-model candle arch line close to the core offer and featured on the home page represents substantial, visible commitment that management will justify continuing.
A one-tier pyramid is a core seasonal item shown prominently on the home page, so it fits the firm's tradition and any weak sales can be blamed on the season.

Although distant from the core, the electronic music box line involved real development investment and home-page promotion, so management will persist and attribute slow uptake to the time needed for market adoption.
As an accessory tied to the music box system the firm committed to, the motif platform is kept to support that line, though its low visibility makes it more expendable.
The Christmas motif platform is only mentioned on the website and is less committed, but it complements the music box investment and is likely retained as seasonal stock.
A Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's established craft identity and is promoted on the home page, making it a natural keep.
